verdict.rationale: CIPO's own pages publish an "IP Horizons – Bulk data" offering and "Canadian IP databases and downloadable bulk data". The patents page also lets users "download patent office records", so registry extracts are available without scraping. The evidence is only link titles, with no detail on content or delivery. Missing for 10: documented dataset formats, coverage and update frequency, licensing or access terms, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the bulk downloads work.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
